summary: Render queue and command buffer: manages queued rendering passes via an intrusive circular doubly-linked list at self+0x110 and dispatches pass commands via virtual method slot 0x54.
evidence: Gfx_RenderQueue_PushPass (0x0019511C) enqueues pass descriptors into linked list at self+0x110 via func_00123594 and invokes virtual render command at vtable slot +0x54 with pass id 0x2C and mask -1.

fields.name: unknown_vtableSlot54Artifact
fields.evidence: Spurious field from struct_db parsing '*(code **)(*param_1 + 0x54)': interpreted as word indexing at param_1 + 0x54*4 = param_1 + 0x150 (336); actually an indirect call through vtable slot 0x54, not a struct field access.

summary: BCH graphics resource descriptor: holds a pointer to resource dictionary tables for string-keyed lookups of models, textures, animations, and layout panes.
evidence: Four string-keyed getter methods Gfx_ResDesc_GetValueA (0x001941D4), GetValueB (0x001943B8), GetValueC (0x00194620), and GetValueD (0x0019466C) access resource symbol tries and parallel value arrays through self->f_90.

fields.name: resourceDictionary
fields.evidence: Read in Gfx_ResDesc_GetValueA (0x001941D4), GetValueB (0x001943B8), GetValueC (0x00194620), and GetValueD (0x0019466C) to look up resource entries in symbol tries and parallel value arrays at offsets +0x94/+0x90, +0x7C/+0x78, +0x40/+0x3C, and +0x4C/+0x48 via Gfx_ResourceTrie_Lookup.

summary: 2D scene manager: sets up top-screen viewport registers and manages 2D layer scroll buffers for scene rendering.
evidence: Gfx_Scene2D_InitViewport (0x00626A1C) configures top-screen viewport dimensions (400x240) and links scroll region registers at device+0x1308 to self->f_88; Gfx_Scene2D_ResetScroll (0x00626338) clears scroll coordinates.

fields.name: scrollLayerBuffer
fields.evidence: Passed to func_005642AC(&device+0x1308, self->f_88, 0x100, 0x200) during 2D scene viewport setup in Gfx_Scene2D_InitViewport (0x00626A1C), where func_005642AC stores the pointer into the device scroll register at +0x04 with 256x512 wrap dimensions.

summary: 2D scene sprite and animation track manager: owns sprite animation tracks, transforms, and memory allocator references.
evidence: maybe_Gfx_SceneSprite2D_InitAnimSlots (0x0060E110) and BattleScene_ResetAndInitTimeTracks (0x00608710) pass self->f_b8 as heap allocator to Anim_TimeTrack_Init (0x0043DC1C) to allocate track keyframe buffers.

fields.name: heap
fields.evidence: Passed as the heap allocator pointer in &{g_table, self->f_b8} to Anim_TimeTrack_Init (0x0043DC1C) in maybe_Gfx_SceneSprite2D_InitAnimSlots (0x0060E110) and BattleScene_ResetAndInitTimeTracks (0x00608710), where Mem_AllocAligned_2 allocates keyframe list nodes using *(u32*)(heap + 4).

summary: Screen-views collection and viewport manager: manages render passes across three view entry arrays (16 short entries, 32 full screen views, 36 projection descriptors) and filters them using a screen/view mask.
evidence: Gfx_ScreenViews_Ctor (0x00622C9C) initializes three entry arrays, sets sub-object at +0xAB0 and initializes screenMask at +0xAB8 to 0xFF; Gfx_ScreenViews_InitBuffers (0x006227CC) uses the mask to filter view entries and top/bottom screen configurations.

fields.name: screenMask
fields.evidence: Initialized to 0xFF in Gfx_ScreenViews_Ctor (0x00622C9C); in Gfx_ScreenViews_InitBuffers (0x006227CC) it is bitwise-ANDed against entry flags (entry->f_52 & self->screenMask, entry->f_81 & self->screenMask) and tested against 1 and 2 to select active 3DS screens.

summary: Skeletal animation frame work descriptor: tracks node buffer offsets, bone counts, and initialization state for model skeletal pose calculation.
evidence: maybe_Gfx_SkeletalAnim_InitFrame (0x0052E7F4) writes node offset to +0x04, bone count to +0x08, and marks +0x0C as initialized (1); companion methods at 0x0052E918 and 0x0052E958 check +0x0C before invoking updates.

fields.name: isInitialized
fields.evidence: Set to 1 (strb r1, [self, #0xc] where r1 = 1) in maybe_Gfx_SkeletalAnim_InitFrame (0x0052E7F4) after storing node parameters to +0x04 and +0x08; tested in companion function 0x0052E958 (ldrb r0, [self, #0xc]), where non-zero bypasses calling the update callback.
